export const deep = (rows: readonly (readonly number[])[]): number => {
  let total = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    for (const cell of row) {
      if (cell > 0) {
        try {
          if (cell > 10) {
            total += cell;
          }
        } finally {
          total += 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return total;
};
